rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something grand, luxurious, and richly appointed.

example.english: This hotel lobby is really opulent.

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on extravagant luxury or expense rather than visual magnificence.

example.english: Staying in a five-star hotel all the time is opulent for me.

rows.note: Use this especially for something visually splendid, ornate, or magnificent.

example.english: The opulent costume on the stage is very eye-catching.
